descriptionByLocale.en:
Your role
Do you enjoy working in a tax environment where accuracy and compliance matter? As a Tax Specialist, you will support VAT- and real-estate-tax-related compliance activities for Real Estate DACH, ensure high-quality data and documentation, and help deliver reconciliations, analyses and controls. In this role, you will support day-to-day tasks while actively contributing to ongoing process improvements in the tax environment.

We’re looking for a Tax Specialist to support the team with the following responsibilities:

• support quarterly fair value updates, including changes in use, input VAT adjustments and subsidies
• review and validate property allocation ratios
• prepare quarterly VAT returns; review documentation and file supporting documents to ensure timely submission
• perform annual turnover reconciliations and support VAT analyses and audits
• support preparation of real estate capital gains tax statements
• support real estate tax processes
• support direct tax and administrative tasks (e.g., supporting documents, data preparation)
• support continuous improvement of VAT processes and controls
